what: Leave-one-out zero-shot transfer of the LEARNED head+adapter (train on 2 _hpr, apply to held-out 3rd), aggressive min-rank fusion + NER-L3, vs no-head zero-shot (dense+SPLADE+NER).
do_no_harm_fusion: FAILS (restrict-to-base-pool loses 2wiki +5 because its golds are OUTSIDE the base pool; mean 74.13 < aggressive 75.83). Safety-cage is the wrong tool.
verdict: The learned head DOES transfer zero-shot (+1.86 mean, +5 on 2wiki; worst -0.4 on musique = insignificant n=100). Path to robust zero-shot = BROADER diverse training (full-6 head), not a fusion trick.
